baseline.root_contract: independent relative defaults and per-surface overrides
baseline.continuation_default_mismatch: retrieval used services/orchestrator/data/continuation_outbox while storage inventory used .data/orchestrator/continuation_outbox

cost.intentional_duplicate_copies: one timestamped rollback backup per explicitly applied legacy root until operator retirement

failures.failure: the first Windows access probe used the Win32 FILE_ADD_FILE alias that x/sys/windows does not export
failures.resolution: use FILE_WRITE_DATA, whose directory-object meaning is FILE_ADD_FILE, and require Windows plus Linux cross-builds

failures.failure: three compatibility tests inherited the test-wide canonical root and therefore no longer exercised GO_MEMORY_STORE_ROOT fallback
failures.resolution: clear the canonical root only in those explicit compatibility fixtures

failures.failure: rollback trusted editable manifest paths and deduplicated sources were not revalidated immediately before commit
failures.resolution: bind manifest, backup, source, and destination paths to the plan digest and canonical roots; reject symlink and reserved namespace paths; revalidate every source and destination digest before rename

failures.failure: v4.0.6 Compose stored agent_sessions.json directly beneath /data while the v4.0.7 canonical root is nested beneath /data, so selecting the parent directory was correctly rejected as an overlapping migration root
failures.resolution: extend the same manifest-bound migration contract to one explicit regular-file root and require apply-plus-rollback tests for /data/agent_sessions.json-shaped upgrades before any runtime restart

failures.failure: Dockerfile.gateway-go copied only top-level gateway Go files, so the new internal/gatewaystate package was absent from the image build context
failures.resolution: copy services/gateway-go/internal into the build stage and enforce that package boundary in the closeout regression suite

failures.failure: the current gateway process reproduced a nonzero exit code on SIGTERM despite no OOM or container error because the HTTP server had no signal-aware drain path
failures.resolution: handle SIGTERM and SIGINT with a bounded HTTP shutdown, test both successful drain and timeout-close paths, give Compose a 30-second grace period, and require isolated exit-zero plus live shutdown-receipt evidence

reproduction: cd services/gateway-go && GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 go build ./...
cd services/gateway-go && GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build ./...

rollback.configuration: remove CONTEXTLATTICE_GATEWAY_STATE_ROOT to restore GO_MEMORY_STORE_ROOT, MEMORY_BANK_ROOT, global-home, or user-home precedence
rollback.surface_override: set an existing per-surface path variable; it remains higher priority
rollback.migration: run contextlattice state rollback with the exact root-bound manifest and --yes before retiring the timestamped backup
rollback.release: revert the gateway-state-root commit and restore the prior gateway image only after proving the old state locations remain intact
